One cdi:InstanceVariable per column of the CSV export: hidden columns and the portal's ':@computed_region' columns are left out. name is the display name and alternateName the API field name; dataTypeName gives the XSD type (cdif:physicalDataType); cachedContents smallest and largest give minValue and maxValue of a numeric column.

Written by the columns row. count non_null and null: one cdi:Statistics 'count' whose values have cdi:computationBase Total ValidOnly and MissingOnly; top: its cdi:CategoryStatistics; cardinality: a cdi:Statistics 'distinct count'. smallest and largest of a text or date column are not converted: a cdi:Statistic value is a number.
A cdif:Key on the variable of that column; the columns row also gives the variable cdif:role UnitIdentifier.
A dataset-level cdi:Statistics 'row count', when every column's cachedContents gives the same count. The view has no row count of its own.
A tabular view: its full CSV export (/api/views/{id}/rows.csv) as a cdi:TabularTextDataSet, with one physical mapping per column.
A tabular view: its query endpoint (/resource/{id}.{format}) as a schema:WebAPI with one SearchAction. The view does not carry the endpoint; it is built from the host and id.
A file asset: the file, with blobFilename, blobMimeType and blobFileSize.
An external-link asset: one DataDownload per URL of metadata.additionalAccessPoints or, without them, metadata.accessPoints.
What one row is ('311 Service Request'): a PropertyValue 'Row label'. CDIF has no dataset-level property for the unit of observation.
